description.text: There are A, B, C three levels of scholarship for you to apply according to your overall evaluation. Click the small picture to view the full-sized picture. How much do I have to pay to get my Scholarship? For the service fee, generally speaking, SICAS will only charge you 10% of the 4 or 3 years of total scholarship amount (there could be a bit difference according to the exact Type of Scholarship that you choose). However, in the beginning , only $300 to $400 need to be paid as a minimum service fee and $75 as application fee to the university at first. When SICAS help you successfully get the scholarship,then the price difference need to be paid. For example: If you get the Undergraduate C Level of Shandong Jiaotong University, The total cost will be: RMB 9000x 4years x 10% =RMB 3600 = USD 600. and since you have paid USD 400, then the price difference: USD 600 - USD 400 = USD 200 need to be paid. Scholarship Guaranteed ? Yes. -After you paid the Scholarship Service Fee as above table listed, SICAS will guarantee you the scholarship! It is true. -Refund or not ? 100% refund if SICAS failed to get the scholarship (Application Fee +Service Fee) for you! Refund Policy Declaration from SICAS board as following sealed and singed. Click the small picture to view the full-sized picture. Objectives The graduate program in Materials Science and Engineering aims to provide solid theory and systematic technological knowledge to our students so that they will be able to engage in high level teaching and researching in the field of Materials Science and Engineering, and assume leadership role in their future work. We encourage our students to be independent, innovative, and socially responsible with good professional ethics. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5 to 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Information Functional Materials 2. Advanced Energy Materials 3. Biomaterials 4. Electronic Packaging 5. Nanomaterials Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 29 credits with 16 credits for degree courses. Inquiry to email: scholarship@sicas.cn

duration.text: The Materials Science and Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree 4) Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 5) Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) 6) Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 35. 4. Have attained a Bachelor's diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
